about: The professional-sound demo of 2026-11-13: the W1 battle card (battle_troy_2026-11-12.json, the same four LTX clips) with the scene-aware design of episode/cue_sheet: spots only for what each clip shows (horses behind the column, the fires on the ridge, the charge with chariots and horses), a war horn as the off-screen signal the column surges on, a tense cue under the talk and an aggressive cue for the charge, crossfaded at the c3->c4 cut where a riser lands.

clips.what: a column marching at the camera on a dusty plain, horses behind
the general and the commander in armour, the army and horses behind
the commander points at the ridge, small fires on the ridge, chariots, then the column surges
a wide charge towards the city, chariots and horses in dust

spots.what: the small fires on the ridge
the chariots waiting below the ridge
the signal the column surges on (off-screen)

intended_pauses.why: he sees the ridge, then gives the order
